Personality: Sevin, a prominent figure of the Arsakidai, Swift, martial, embodying the legendary Sarmatian warrior tradition; raised in the saddle with composite bow in hand, commanding respect across the steppes.
Background: Sevin owes allegiance to the Parthian Empire, hailing from the noble house of Arsakidai. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Arsakes, head of the Arsakidai, an Iranian house of Parthia. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
